metadata.title: वारली आदिवासी का इतिहास रिकॉर्ड करती पेंटिंग | These paintings are records of Warli Adivasi life
metadata.description: Today, Warli painting is known all over the world . The credit for popularizing this folk art is given to Soma Jiva Mahse. His family is still engaged in carrying forward this tradition. But despite the efforts of this family, the condition of the artists doing Warli paintings is not very good. We travelled to the villages of Dahanu block in Palghar district of Maharashtra to meet a few of the warli artists.
